positive_controls.argument: The complete wait/rework path identifies whether executable evidence reaches its decision while useful; an outside test-environment queue can invalidate a locally fast demonstration schedule.

The mapped observation and response delays reveal whether a next exposure stage occurs before useful harm evidence arrives; downstream recovery belongs inside the affected path.
Stable end-to-end entry/exit boundaries and inclusion of off-board waits provide the denominator and interval needed to interpret lead-time and throughput indicators.
The actual map locates waits for decisions outside the team and makes the effect of delegation visible in total delivery time, not just local activity.
Cross-team waits, rework loops and interface handoffs expose coordination delays that disappear in separate local boards.
Extending the path to operational feedback and support exposes shifted maintenance burdens that a project-completion endpoint conceals.
Detection, triage, decision, fix, deployment and confirmation delays locate where operational learning loses timeliness, including repeated failed fixes.
The evidence path exposes capture, reconciliation and authority-review waits and helps compare lightweight continuous capture with a late package.
The work path identifies waits and rework attributable to actual knowledge bottlenecks, directing a sharing intervention to the affected work.
The consumer-to-operator path includes platform adoption, support, migration and escape costs, revealing queue transfer hidden by local automation speed.
Visible downstream waits, rework and residual support stages contribute to the remaining-cost and time estimate used to compare continuation with stopping.
The complete creation/update/retrieval path exposes stale-document handoffs and shows whether an additional document improves total decision latency.
Mapping baseline creation, reconciliation and promotion waits exposes expensive state handoffs without collapsing readiness into calendar progress.
Including build, deployment and readback stages reveals delays or omissions between approved intent and available actual-state evidence.
Including review waits and downstream rework exposes whether a control reduces total risk-adjusted work or merely transfers delay.
The work map includes both producer and consumer handoffs and integration rework, locating delay caused by asynchronous interface changes.
The map exposes batching and scarce-test-facility waits and distinguishes early local feedback from the later relevant-level evidence decision.
Creation, repair and query waits supply the actual workflow cost of trace use and expose a link-production bottleneck with no useful consumer.
The mapped path retains detection, triage, correction, recheck and accepted-residual branches, exposing ticket closures that merely move work off-board.
The end-to-end evidence-to-decision path reveals whether a proposed review delays useful feedback or takes place after commitment has already hardened.
The path identifies whether an increment yields timely learning before the next irreversible commitment or merely shifts final integration to the end.
The complete system path reveals local completion that waits on another level and exposes synchronization/rework costs of recursion.
Stable path boundaries, elapsed waits and rework observations provide comparable actuals and reveal the portion hidden by active-work estimates.
The complete path exposes vendor waits and procurement commitments outside the local board, including evidence and rights needed before integration.
Including people, data, procedure, support and rehearsal work reveals a false delivery endpoint at product-test completion.
The complete response path includes access, backup retrieval, reconciliation and downstream restoration, testing whether a claimed recovery-time budget omits waiting.
Through-life work mapping exposes support and supplier queues omitted by delivery-only measures and supplies observed maintenance burdens.
The handoff/reconciliation path exposes duplicated data entry and access bottlenecks, contributing to a comparison of a digital environment with simpler records.
The full pipeline-plus-human path includes queue, flaky-test repair and authority waits, locating where continuous generation fails to yield timely evidence.
